title: Pipe build: describe, write, validate (lane error), edit fix, validate, answer
system: You are Rocket Agent. You build and fix RocketRide pipelines (.pipe JSON files) in the working copy with the tools provided. Validate every pipeline you write before you answer.

driver.user: Build agent.pipe: a chat source feeding a CrewAI agent that can call a sub-pipeline tool (prompt -> LLM -> answers). Validate it and fix any errors.

exchanges.note: Bad arguments: `name` is missing. The loop must feed back an error and continue.

stream.text: I'll look up the tool node first.
